name: Sessions Health
short_description: Affordable, therapist-designed mental health EHR with simple pricing, unlimited features, and no hidden costs.
long_description: Sessions Health is a therapist-designed, HIPAA-compliant EHR built specifically for mental health care. Founded in 2018 in Minneapolis, Minnesota by a team including psychotherapist Ian Felton, Sessions Health focuses on providing simple, affordable, and accessible practice management tools for behavioral health professionals. The platform offers scheduling, documentation, online payments, client portal, billing tools, unlimited clients, unlimited storage, secure messaging, assessments, and reporting. Unlike many competitors, Sessions Health doesn't charge extra for appointment reminders, client portal, or document storage. The company is proud to offer transparent pricing with no hidden fees or forced price increases. Sessions Health emphasizes the therapeutic alliance and client relationship as much as practice operations, positioning itself as 'the most philosophically-aligned EHR company mental health providers can trust.'
one_liner: The affordable, ethical EHR designed by therapists who understand the therapeutic alliance.
best_for: Solo therapists and counselors seeking affordable, transparent pricing
Small group practices wanting unlimited features without per-feature fees
Clinicians frustrated with price increases from other EHRs
not_for: Addiction treatment centers needing specialized features

pricing.notes: Freemium: free for up to 3 active clients. Professional: $39/month for first practitioner (unlimited clients), $29/month each additional practitioner. Unlimited administrative staff: free. Optional Telehealth: $10/month per practitioner. Electronic claims: $0.19-$0.25 per claim (volume-based). No extra charges for reminders, portal, or storage.

faqs.q: How much does Sessions Health cost?
faqs.a: Sessions Health offers a free plan for up to 3 clients. The Professional plan is $39/month for the first practitioner (unlimited clients) and $29/month for each additional practitioner. Admin staff are unlimited and free. Telehealth is $10/month optional add-on.

faqs.q: Does Sessions Health have hidden fees?
faqs.a: No, Sessions Health emphasizes transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Unlike competitors, they don't charge extra for appointment reminders, client portal, or document storage. Electronic claims are $0.19-$0.25 each.

faqs.q: Is Sessions Health good for solo therapists?
faqs.a: Yes, Sessions Health is particularly well-suited for solo therapists and small group practices. The affordable pricing, freemium option, and therapist-designed workflows make it popular with independent clinicians.
Telehealth is available as an optional add-on at $10/month per practitioner. It includes HIPAA-compliant video sessions, waiting rooms, screen sharing, in-session chat, and multi-participant support.
